questions.question: Karad, which was recognised by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs for achieving 100 % segregation, collection, and processing of sanitary and biomedical waste in April 2025, is located in which of the following districts?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Satara district**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karad**, a prominent city in the state of **Maharashtra**, is located within the **Satara district**. It has gained significant national attention for its excellence in urban waste management.
 
• In **April 2025**, the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)** officially recognized the city for achieving **100% segregation, collection, and processing** of both **sanitary** and **biomedical waste**.
 
• This milestone reflects the city's commitment to the **Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) 2.0**, which emphasizes making cities "Garbage Free" and ensuring the scientific processing of all categories of waste.
 
• The recognition highlights the successful implementation of decentralized waste processing models, where **biomedical waste** from hospitals and **sanitary waste** from households are handled without contaminating regular municipal solid waste. ***Hence, the correct answer is Satara district.***
 
• The city's administration utilized advanced tracking and specialized collection vehicles to ensure that no **hazardous waste** reaches the landfills, setting a benchmark for other **Grade-C** municipal councils in **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographical Significance:**
 
 
• **Karad** is situated at the **confluence (Sangam)** of the **Krishna** and **Koyna** rivers. This confluence is locally known as **"Preeti Sangam"**, which translates to the "Confluence of Love."
 
• The city is located at an altitude of approximately **566 meters** and is a major educational and industrial hub in **Western Maharashtra**.
 
 
 
• **Satara District:**
 
 
• The district was the seat of the **Maratha Empire** in the **18th century** and served as the capital under **Chhatrapati Shahu I**.
 
• It is home to the famous **Kaas Plateau** (Valley of Flowers), which is a **UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site**.
 
 
 
• **Biomedical Waste Management:**
 
 
• Management of such waste is governed by the **Biomedical Waste Management Rules, 2016**, which require the segregation of waste into color-coded bags (**Yellow, Red, White, and Blue**) to prevent health risks.
 
• The achievement in **2025** signifies that **Karad** has successfully integrated these rules into its daily municipal operations.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with other Options:**
 
 
• **Indore district** (Madhya Pradesh) is consistently ranked as **India's cleanest city** in the **Swachh Survekshan** but is distinct from the specific recognition given to **Karad**.
 
• **Coimbatore district** is located in **Tamil Nadu** and is known for its textile industry, while **Dehradun district** is the capital of **Uttarakhand**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Swachh Survekshan:** It is an annual survey of cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitation in villages, cities, and towns across **India**, launched as part of the **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** in **2016**.
 
• **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs:** This ministry is the nodal agency for the **Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban)** and is headed by a **Union Cabinet Minister**.
 
• **Waste Segregation:** The **100% segregation** target involves separating **Wet waste (biodegradable)**, **Dry waste (recyclable)**, and **Domestic Hazardous waste** (including sanitary napkins and diapers) at the source.
 
• **Environmental Impact:** By processing **100% of biomedical waste**, **Karad** prevents the spread of infectious diseases and reduces the soil and groundwater pollution often caused by unscientific disposal.
</ul

questions.question: Which Odisha sand-artist created a sand sculpture celebrating the 2025 Union Budget?

• The sculpture typically features the **Finance Minister** or symbolic representations of the **Budget**, such as the digital tablet, alongside slogans that highlight the government's fiscal goals for the year **2025**.
 
• **Sudarsan Pattnaik** is known for using his unique medium of **sand art** to raise awareness about socio-economic policies, making complex subjects like the **Union Budget** accessible to the general public.
 
• The artwork usually incorporates **vibrant colors** and intricate details to represent various sectors like **Agriculture, Infrastructure, and Technology**, which are often the focal points of the **Budget** presentation.

__
 
• **About Sudarsan Pattnaik:**
 
 
• He was born in **1977** in **Puri, Odisha**. He is a self-taught artist who started creating sand art at the age of **7**.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri**, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in **2014** for his immense contribution to the field of art.
 
• He has represented **India** in more than **60 international sand art championships** and has won numerous awards, including the **Golden Sand Art Award**.
 
• He also holds a **Guinness World Record** for creating the **world's tallest sandcastle**, which stood at **48 feet and 8 inches** in **2017**.
 
 
 
• **Other Sand Artists mentioned:**

• The **Union Budget**, also referred to as the **Annual Financial Statement** under **Article 112** of the **Constitution of India**, is presented every year on **February 1st**.
 
• The **2025 Union Budget** was presented by **Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman**, marking a significant milestone in India's fiscal planning for the **2025-26** financial year.
 
• The budget process involves the **Finance Ministry**, the **NITI Aayog**, and various spending ministries to determine the allocation of funds for the upcoming **fiscal year**.
 
• Public celebrations and artistic tributes like those by **Pattnaik** help in fostering a sense of national participation in the country's economic journey.

questions.question: According to the World Bank’s 2025 assessment, how many people moved out of extreme poverty in India between 2011-12 and 2022-23?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**171 million**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **World Bank’s 2025 assessment** (based on the latest consumption data), India has made significant strides in poverty reduction, with approximately **171 million** people moving out of extreme poverty between **2011-12** and **2022-23**.
 
• The assessment utilizes data from the **Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2022-23** to estimate poverty levels following a long gap since the last official survey in **2011-12**.
 
• The **extreme poverty rate** in India, measured at the international poverty line of **$2.15 per day** (2017 PPP), declined from **18.7%** in **2011-12** to **4.6%** in **2022-23**.
 
• The reduction was particularly pronounced in **rural areas**, where the poverty headcount ratio dropped from **21.2%** to **5.3%** over the same period.
 
• The report indicates that **real per capita consumption** grew at an average annual rate of **2.9%**, contributing significantly to the lifting of millions out of the lowest income bracket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Poverty Line:** The **World Bank** updated the global extreme poverty line to **$2.15** per person per day in **September 2022**, based on **2017 Purchasing Power Parities (PPP)**. This threshold reflects the average of the national poverty lines of the world’s poorest countries.
 
• **Purchasing Power Parity (PPP):** This is a metric used to compare the **economic productivity** and standards of living between countries by adjusting for the **relative cost of local goods and services** and the **inflation rates** of the countries.
 
• **Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP):** This is the **World Bank’s** interactive tool for reporting on global **poverty** and **inequality** statistics, where the updated Indian data for **2022-23** was integrated to provide a more accurate global poverty headcount.
 
• **Government Interventions:** Significant contributors to this decline include social welfare schemes such as the **Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)**, which provided free foodgrains to approximately **800 million** people, and the **Jal Jeevan Mission**, which improved health outcomes through piped water.
 
• **Urban Poverty Trends:** While rural poverty saw a massive decline, **urban poverty** also decreased from **12.1%** in **2011-12** to **2.7%** in **2022-23**, showing that growth was largely inclusive across different geographical segments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Data Gap:** India did not release an official **Consumer Expenditure Survey (CES)** between **2011-12** and **2022-23**, leading to various independent estimations by economists before the **World Bank’s 2025** official update confirmed the **171 million** figure.
 
• **HCES 2022-23:** The **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)**, under the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)**, conducted this survey with a revised methodology, which the **World Bank** adjusted to ensure comparability with previous years.
 
• **Gini Index:** The data also suggests a slight reduction in **consumption inequality**. The **Gini coefficient** for rural India fell from **0.287** to **0.266**, indicating a narrowing gap between the rich and the poor in terms of consumption.
 
• **Global Context:** India’s successful reduction of extreme poverty is a critical component of the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 1**, which aims to end poverty in all its forms everywhere by **2030**.

47:T251e

questions.question: Which of the following organisations released a special postage stamp and a ₹100 commemorative coin during its centenary celebrations in October 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)** is celebrating its **centenary year** (100th anniversary) in **October 2025**.
 
• To commemorate this historic milestone, the **Government of India** announced the release of a **special postage stamp** and a **₹100 commemorative coin**.
 
• The organization was founded on **September 27, 1925**, on the auspicious day of **Vijayadashami**, by **Dr. Keshav Baliram Hedgewar**.
 
• The primary headquarters of the organization is located in **Nagpur**, **Maharashtra**, which serves as the center for its nationwide activities.
 
• The decision to issue the **₹100 coin** and **postage stamp** is a recognition of the organization's long-standing influence on India's social, cultural, and political landscape over the last **century**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History and Foundation of RSS:**
 
 
• The **RSS** was established with the aim of providing character training through Hindu discipline and to unite the Hindu community to form a **Hindu Rashtra**.
 
• **Dr. Keshav Baliram Hedgewar**, the founding **Sarsanghchalak**, was a physician from **Nagpur** who sought to create a nationalist volunteer corps.
 
• Following **Dr. Hedgewar**, **M.S. Golwalkar** (popularly known as **Guruji**) served as the second **Sarsanghchalak** and significantly expanded the organization's ideological reach.
 
 
 
• **Other Organizations Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Indian National Congress (INC):** Founded in **December 1885** by **A.O. Hume**, it played a central role in the Indian Independence Movement. Its centenary was celebrated in **1985**.
 
• **All India Radio (AIR):** Established in **1936** as the national public radio broadcaster of India, it is one of the largest radio networks in the world and is officially known as **Akashvani** since **1956**.
 
• **Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh (BMS):** Founded on **July 23, 1955**, by **Dattopant Thengadi**, it is the largest central trade union organization in India and is an affiliate of the **Sangh Parivar**.
 
 
 
• **Commemorative Coins in India:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of Finance** issues commemorative coins to honor prominent personalities, historical events, or organizations on their **75th, 100th, or 125th anniversaries**.
 
• The **₹100 coin** for the **RSS centenary** is a non-circulating legal tender intended for collection and historical documentation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Structure of RSS:** The organization operates through daily gatherings known as **Shakhas**, where volunteers (**Swayamsevaks**) participate in physical drills and ideological discussions.
 
• **Sangh Parivar:** The **RSS** is the parent organization of a large family of affiliated bodies known as the **Sangh Parivar**, which includes the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, **Vishwa Hindu Parishad (VHP)**, and **Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP)**.
 
• **Sarsanghchalak:** The current **Sarsanghchalak** (Chief) of the **RSS** is **Mohan Bhagwat**, who has held the position since **2009**.
 
• **Centenary Goals:** As part of the **2025 celebrations**, the organization aims to expand its presence to every **Mandal** (cluster of villages) across **India** to strengthen its grassroots outreach.

questions.question: The Second China–Central Asia Summit, held on 16–18 June 2025, took place in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Astana, Kazakhstan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Second China–Central Asia Summit** was officially scheduled to be held in **Astana**, the capital city of **Kazakhstan**, from **16 to 18 June 2025**.
 
• This high-level diplomatic event brought together the **President of China** and the leaders of the five Central Asian nations: **Kazakhstan**, **Kyrgyzstan**, **Tajikistan**, **Turkmenistan**, and **Uzbekistan**.
 
• The summit serves as the primary platform for the **C+C5 (China plus Central Asia)** cooperation mechanism, which was elevated to the heads-of-state level to strengthen regional ties.
 
• During the inaugural summit in **2023**, it was agreed that the hosting of the summit would alternate between **China** and the **Central Asian** countries every **two years**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Astana, Kazakhstan.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Context:** The **First China–Central Asia Summit** took place in **May 2023** in the city of **Xi'an**, **China**. This landmark event resulted in the **Xi'an Declaration** and established a blueprint for long-term cooperation in trade and security.
 
• **Geopolitical Significance:** The **C+C5 mechanism** is a strategic initiative by **Beijing** to consolidate its influence in **Central Asia**, focusing on the **Belt and Road Initiative (BRI)** and providing an alternative to traditional regional structures dominated by other global powers.
 
• **Economic Cooperation:** **China** is currently one of the largest trading partners for the region. Total trade volume between **China** and the five **Central Asian** countries exceeded **$89 billion** in **2023**, driven largely by **energy exports** and **infrastructure projects**.
 
• **Key Themes:** The **2025 Summit** in **Astana** focused on expanding **interconnectivity**, including the development of the **Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (Middle Corridor)** and enhancing cooperation in **digital economy** and **green energy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Permanent Secretariat:** To ensure the continuity of the summit's objectives, a **China-Central Asia Secretariat** was officially inaugurated in **March 2024** in **Xi'an**, **China**.
 
• **Energy Security:** Central Asia remains vital to **China's** energy needs, specifically through the **China–Central Asia Gas Pipeline**, which traverses **Turkmenistan**, **Uzbekistan**, and **Kazakhstan** before entering **Xinjiang**.
 
• **Security Dimensions:** Beyond economics, the summits address regional stability, focusing on the "three evils" of **terrorism**, **separatism**, and **extremism**, often coordinating with **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)** frameworks.
 
• **Visa-Free Regimes:** In the lead-up to and following these summits, **China** has expanded **mutual visa-free travel** agreements with countries like **Kazakhstan** and **Uzbekistan** to promote **people-to-people exchanges** and tourism.

questions.question: Which of the following protected areas in Odisha is proposed to be upgraded to a National Park, thereby becoming the state’s third national park as of September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Odisha Government** has formally moved a proposal to the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** to upgrade the **Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary** to a **National Park**.
 
• Once the notification is finalized by **September 2025**, it will officially become the **third National Park** in the state of **Odisha**. ***Hence, option 1 is correct.***
 
• Currently, **Odisha** has only two designated National Parks: **Similipal National Park** in **Mayurbhanj** and **Bhitarkanika National Park** in **Kendrapara**.
 
• The sanctuary is spread over an area of approximately **342.91 square kilometers** and is located in the **Sambalpur district**.
 
• The upgrade is intended to provide higher statutory protection to the habitat, which boasts one of the highest **herbivore densities** in the country and is a significant **Eco-Sensitive Zone**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographical Features**:
 
 
• **Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary** is situated on the **Barapahad hills** and serves as a crucial catchment area for the **Hirakud Dam**, which is one of the longest earthen dams in the world.
 
• The sanctuary is famous for its "dry deciduous forests" and its proximity to the **Mahanadi River**, making it a prime spot for **ecotourism**.
 
 
 
• **Flora and Fauna**:
 
 
• It is home to a significant population of **Indian Gaur** (Bison), **Leopards**, and the **four-horned antelope** (**Chousingha**).
 
• The **Hirakud Reservoir** adjacent to the sanctuary attracts more than **1.5 lakh** migratory birds of nearly **50 species** during the **winter season**.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance**:
 
 
• The sanctuary has historical links to the legendary freedom fighter **Veer Surendra Sai**, who utilized the dense forests of **Barapahad** as a base for his guerrilla warfare against the **British** during the **1857** uprising.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Framework**:
 
 
• A **National Park** is established under the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**. Unlike a sanctuary, no human activity or private land rights are permitted inside a National Park unless specifically authorized.
 
• The **State Government** has the power to declare an area a National Park by notification if it is considered to be of adequate ecological, faunal, or floral importance.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Options**:
 
 
• **Bhitarkanika Wildlife Sanctuary**: Part of this sanctuary was declared a **National Park** in **1998**. It is a **Ramsar site** known for its **mangroves** and **saltwater crocodiles**.
 
• **Satkosia Gorge Wildlife Sanctuary**: Located in the **Angul district**, it was declared a **Tiger Reserve** in **2007**. It is famous for the **Gharial** conservation program in the **Mahanadi River**.
 
• **Sunabeda Wildlife Sanctuary**: Situated in the **Nuapada district**, it is known for the rare **wild buffalo** and has been proposed as a **Tiger Reserve** to expand the conservation area for big cats in the **central Indian landscape**.
 
 
</ul

questions.question: Which summit held in New Delhi from 10 to 12 April 2025 had the theme “Sambhavna”?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Global Technology Summit, 2025**__.

__
 
• The **Global Technology Summit (GTS) 2025** was held in **New Delhi** from **10 to 12 April 2025**. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• The **theme** of the summit for the year **2025** was **“Sambhavna”**, which translates to **“Possibility”**, highlighting the transformative potential of emerging technologies.
 
• This summit is a premier event that brings together **policymakers**, **industry leaders**, and **technologists** to discuss the **geopolitical** and **economic** implications of technology.
 
• The **2025 edition** focused heavily on the regulation and advancement of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, **Semiconductors**, and **Quantum Computing**.
 
• The event served as a platform for **India** to showcase its **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)** and its role as a leader in the **Global South** for technological cooperation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Digital India Summit, 2025**:
 
 
• This summit focuses on the progress of the **Digital India** program, launched in **2015**, which aims to transform the country into a **digitally empowered society**.
 
• It focuses on **e-governance**, **broadband connectivity**, and digital literacy rather than the broader geopolitical tech themes of **“Sambhavna”**. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **India Internet Governance Forum (IIGF), 2025**:
 
 
• The **IIGF** is a multi-stakeholder platform that discusses public policy issues related to **Internet governance**.
 
• It follows the principles of the **United Nations Internet Governance Forum** and focuses on topics like **cybersecurity** and **net neutrality**. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **World Startup Summit, 2025**:
 
 
• This event is dedicated to the **entrepreneurial ecosystem**, connecting **founders**, **venture capitalists**, and **investors**.
 
• Its primary goal is to foster **innovation** and **business scaling** rather than diplomatic technology policy. ***Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Geopolitical Context**:
 
 
• The **Global Technology Summit** is typically co-hosted by the **Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)** of **India** and **Carnegie India**.
 
• It has become a vital part of **India’s tech-diplomacy**, addressing how **data sovereignty** and **critical technologies** affect international relations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the Theme:** The word **“Sambhavna”** emphasizes a shift from **uncertainty** to **opportunity** in the digital age, reflecting **India's** vision of **self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat)** in high-tech sectors.
 
• **Key Participants:** The **2025** summit saw participation from over **50 countries**, including **G20** members and **ASEAN** partners, highlighting the global importance of **New Delhi** as a tech hub.
 
• **Focus on AI Ethics:** A major portion of the **April 2025** discussions was dedicated to establishing **global norms** for **Responsible AI** and mitigating the risks of **deepfakes** and **misinformation**.

questions.question: Which shallow-water craft was commissioned into the Indian military in June 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Arnala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **INS Arnala** is the lead ship of the **Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW SWC)** project, designed specifically to bolster the **Indian Navy's** capabilities in coastal waters.
 
• It was built by **Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE)** in **Kolkata**. The contract for eight such vessels was signed between the **Ministry of Defence** and **GRSE** in **April 2019**.
 
• The vessel is named after the **Arnala Island**, located off the coast of **Vasai, Maharashtra**, which holds significant maritime historical importance from the era of **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**.
 
• The primary role of **INS Arnala** includes **anti-submarine warfare** operations in coastal waters, **Low Intensity Maritime Operations (LIMO)**, and **mine-laying** operations.
 
• Equipped with advanced **sonar** and **torpedo launchers**, the ship is designed to detect and neutralize enemy submarines in shallow waters where larger vessels may struggle to operate efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Project ASW SWC:**
 
 
• This project aims to replace the aging **Abhay-class** corvettes of the **Indian Navy**.
 
• The ships have a displacement of approximately **750 tons** and can achieve a maximum speed of **25 knots**.
 
• These crafts are powered by **water-jet propulsion**, which provides high maneuverability in shallow coastal regions.
 
 
 
• **INS Nilgiri:**
 
 
• It is the lead ship of **Project 17A** stealth frigates.
 
• Built by **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL)**, these ships feature advanced **stealth features**, weapons, and sensors.
 
 
 
• **INS Surat:**
 
 
• This is the fourth and final ship of the **Project 15B** (Visakhapatnam-class) guided-missile destroyers.
 
• It represents one of the most advanced **destroyer** classes in the **Indian Navy**, named after the commercial capital of **Gujarat**.
 
 
 
• **INS Vaghsheer:**
 
 
• It is the sixth and final submarine of the **Kalvari-class** (Project 75), based on the **Scorpene** design.
 
• These are **diesel-electric attack submarines** designed for various missions including anti-surface warfare and intelligence gathering.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indigenization:** The **ASW SWC** ships like **INS Arnala** boast over **80% indigenous content**, aligning with the **Aatmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-reliant India) initiative.
 
• **Specifications:** The craft has a length of **77 meters** and is equipped with **lightweight torpedoes** and **ASW rockets** to counter sub-surface threats effectively.
 
• **Strategic Depth:** By securing the coastal waters, these shallow-water crafts allow the **Indian Navy's** larger capital ships, like **aircraft carriers** and **destroyers**, to focus on deep-sea blue-water operations.
 
• **Operational Range:** The vessel has an endurance of **1,800 nautical miles**, ensuring a persistent presence across the **Indian coastline**.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following honours, awarded in the 2025 King’s Birthday Overseas & International Honours List, specifically recognises British nationals for “outstanding service abroad or internationally”?

options.text: The Order of the British Empire
The Order of St Michael and St George

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Order of St Michael and St George**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Order of St Michael and St George** is the premier honour awarded to **British nationals** and others for **outstanding service abroad or internationally**, particularly in relation to **Foreign and Commonwealth affairs**.
 
• It is traditionally featured in the **King’s Birthday Overseas & International Honours List**, which recognizes individuals serving the **United Kingdom**'s interests internationally or those performing exceptional **charitable or voluntary work** abroad.
 
• Founded in **1818** by the **Prince Regent** (later **King George IV**), the order was originally created to commemorate the **Ionian Islands** becoming a British protectorate and for service in **Malta**.
 
• The order consists of three ranks: **Knight or Dame Grand Cross (GCMG)**, **Knight or Dame Commander (KCMG or DCMG)**, and **Companion (CMG)**.
 
• In the context of the **2025** honours, this specific order is used to reward **diplomats**, **colonial officials**, and individuals involved in **international relations** and **global development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Order of the British Empire**:
 
 
• Established by **King George V** in **1917**, this order recognizes a wide range of service to the **United Kingdom** across many sectors, including **arts, sciences, and public service**.
 
• It includes levels such as **GBE**, **KBE/DBE**, **CBE**, **OBE**, and **MBE**. While it can be awarded to people abroad, it is the standard order for **national achievement** within the **UK**.
 
 
 
• **The Royal Victorian Order**:
 
 
• Founded by **Queen Victoria** in **1896**, this is a **dynastic order** of knighthood.
 
• It is uniquely in the **personal gift of the Monarch** and is awarded for services rendered specifically to the **Sovereign** or members of the **Royal Family**, rather than on the advice of the **Prime Minister**.
 
 
 
• **The King’s Police Medal (KPM)**:
 
 
• This medal is awarded to members of the **police forces** in the **United Kingdom** and **Commonwealth** for **distinguished service** or **gallantry**.
 
• Following the accession of **King Charles III**, the award was renamed from the **Queen's Police Medal**.
 
 
 
• **Selection Process**:
 
 
• Honours in the **Overseas and International List** are recommended by the **Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO)**.
 
• The **2025 King's Birthday Honours** serve as one of two major annual lists (alongside the **New Year Honours**) that celebrate the contributions of individuals to **British society** and the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Motto and Symbolism**: The motto of **The Order of St Michael and St George** is **"Auspicium Melioris Aevi"**, which translates to **"Token of a better age"**.
 
• **The Chapel**: The primary chapel for this order is located within **St Paul's Cathedral** in **London**, which serves as a site for official ceremonies related to the order.
 
• **Eligibility**: While primarily for **British citizens**, **honorary awards** can be made to citizens of countries where the **King** is not **Head of State**.
 
• **Rank Distinction**: The **GCMG** is the highest class and is often reserved for very high-ranking officials such as **Governors-General** or senior **ambassadors**.

questions.question: The Sachet App provides real-time alerts about which type of emergencies?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Natural disasters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sachet App** is a mobile application developed and launched by the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)** to provide citizens with real-time alerts and warnings specifically regarding **natural disasters**.
 
• The application serves as a unified platform under the **Integrated Alert System**, designed to disseminate critical information about impending **emergencies** such as **floods**, **cyclones**, **earthquakes**, **heatwaves**, and **landslides**.
 
• It utilizes a **geo-targeted** mechanism, meaning users receive alerts based on their specific **geographical location**, ensuring that only relevant and timely information reaches those in the danger zone.
 
• The app is built upon the **Common Alerting Protocol (CAP)**, a global standard for emergency messaging that ensures consistency across different communication channels like **SMS**, **Radio**, and **Television**.
 
• In addition to warnings, the app provides **"Do’s and Don’ts"** for various disaster scenarios, empowering citizens with actionable knowledge to ensure their safety during a **natural calamity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA):**
 
 
• It is the apex statutory body for disaster management in **India**, established under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**.
 
• The **NDMA** is chaired by the **Prime Minister of India** and is responsible for laying down policies, plans, and guidelines for disaster management to ensure a timely and effective response.
 
 
 
• **Common Alerting Protocol (CAP):**
 
 
• **CAP** is a digital format for exchanging emergency alerts and public warnings over various networks.
 
• It was implemented in **India** through the **Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT)**, enabling a "one-stop" shop for all **alert-generating agencies**.
 
 
 
• **Technical Collaboration:**
 
 
• The alert system integrates data from various national agencies including the **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** for weather, the **Central Water Commission (CWC)** for floods, and the **Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)** for tsunamis.
 
• The **Sachet App** supports **multi-lingual** alerts, allowing users to receive information in several **regional Indian languages** to overcome linguistic barriers during **crises**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Phased Rollout:** The **CAP-compliant** integrated alert system was rolled out in phases across **India**, starting with high-risk coastal **states** to mitigate the impact of **cyclones**.
 
• **Zero Cost:** The **Sachet App** is a free-to-use government service, aimed at reaching the maximum number of citizens, including those in **rural** and **remote areas**.
 
• **Disaster Resilience:** This initiative is a part of **India's** broader commitment to the **Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction (2015-2030)**, which emphasizes the use of **technology** and early warning systems to save lives.
</ul
